purpose: Fixtures for bfinance.ownership. Every capture is the raw HTTP response body stored byte-for-byte; the module's parsers are tested against the upstream bytes, not against a transcription of them.
capture_method: one request per capture, strictly sequential, >= 2.5 s apart on www.nseindia.com. Headers copied from src/bfinance/nse/corporate_actions.py (browser UA, X-Requested-With, Referer) and the same bounded prime-on-403 retry. NOT needed here: all three routes returned 200 with zero cookies primed, which is the fourth independent measurement of that result on the nseindia.com /api/* family.
note_on_line_endings: Every stored file is byte-identical to the response body: no re-serialisation, no re-indentation, no added trailing newline. None of the three bodies contains CR, so stored_line_endings is lf by inspection and not by conversion.

shareholding_RELIANCE.json.trim_rule: NO TRIM. The whole 40,154-byte body is stored: it is the schema evidence, and a trimmed copy could not answer 'how many keys does a filing carry' or 'does any revision field ever get populated'. 22 of 22 rows, 33 of 33 keys.

shape.served_order: descending by date; the module re-sorts ascending
shape.history_only: newest row is the last filed quarter, 30-JUN-2026; no forward row

measured.off_cycle_note: TWO filings whose `date` is not a calendar quarter end, not one. A one-row-per-quarter parser loses both.
measured.time_difference_identity: timeDifference == systemDate - broadcastDate to the second on all 15 rows carrying both (31-MAR-2024: broadcast 20-APR-2024 00:20:05, system 20-APR-2024 08:05:03, lag 07:44:58 = 27,898 s). Range 3 s to 27,898 s.
measured.time_difference_sentinel: "::" on 7 of 22 rows, and on exactly the 7 rows whose systemDate is null (0 of the 15 populated rows)

restatement.verdict: restatement is MODELLED upstream (the fields are first-class) and UNOBSERVED in this data. No handler for a restatement is claimed to be verified.

units.pr_and_prgrp_and_public_val: percent of total shares, measured: they sum to exactly 100.00 on all 22 rows (50.00-50.66 / 49.34-50.00). The spelling "50" means 50.00.
units.employeeTrusts: UNDECLARED: the string "0" on all 22 rows is consistent with a share count and with a percent. Carried verbatim, never coerced.
units.xbrlFileSize: formatted string e.g. "510.29 KB" (5 of 22 non-null). NOT parsed to bytes: NSE does not state whether KB is 1000 or 1024.
units.recordId: digits on all 22 rows; kept as text

sentinels.\"N\": remarksWeb on 14/22 (upstream 'no notes') AND revisedData on 22/22 (meaning 'not revised'). Two meanings, one spelling, so "N" is deliberately NOT treated as absent.
sentinels.null: revisedDate, revisionDate, typeOfSubmission, isin, cgTimeStamp, countString, format, underlyingDrs on 22/22

measured.composite_key: (symbol, date, broadcastDate) is distinct on all 22 rows. (symbol, date) is also distinct HERE, but (symbol, broadcast DAY) is not: 30-SEP-2021 (02:55:01) and the off-cycle 08-DEC-2021 (03:25:01) were both broadcast on 07-JAN-2022.

shareholding_RELIANCE.json.payload_not_byte_stable: A capture of the same URL on 2026-09-27 was 40,130 bytes with sha256 14aeb3ce299fa240; this one is 40,154 bytes with sha256 55cc778de40d8880. Same 22 rows, same 33 keys, same as-of dates -- a value in some row was revised in place. Any cache over this route must therefore expire.

deals_snapshot_20260925.json.trim_rule: NO TRIM. The whole 54,901-byte body is stored. Truncating the *_DATA arrays would have destroyed the two measured defects this fixture exists to pin: the mixed 24-Sep/25-Sep row dates (which live in the short-deal rows) and the 50% null density of SHORT_DEALS_DATA.

shape.block_deals_sibling_route: /api/snapshot-capital-market-blockdeal returns 404 (route gone). BLOCK_DEALS_DATA rides in this payload, so no second route is needed.
shape.snapshot_only: no history parameter and no date argument on this route. expected_date= in the module is an assertion against the payload, never a request parameter.

trap_1_as_on_date_does_not_cover_short_d.consequence: an as_on_date filter returns 243 rows, of which ZERO are short deals, and looks like a quiet market rather than a missed filter

client_name_is_the_differentiator.collapsed_pair: two AXIOMGAS SELL 186,000 @ 54.75 bulk rows on 25-Sep-2026, separated only by clientName

units.qty: share_count. Every value a digit string. Bulk 20,000-14,550,924; block 357,000-8,600,000; short 1-157,502. The 20,000 bulk floor is the SEBI bulk-deal screen, an independent check on the reading.
units.watp: INR per share (weighted average traded price). 8.97-2,905.0. Qty x WATP lands at 0.03-2,498.30 INR crore, the right order for these deal sizes.
units.notional: NOT PUBLISHED. qty*watp is derivable; the module exposes it as NotionalCr and labels it DERIVED in attrs and UNITS.
units.remarks: bulk: the string "-" on 237/237. block: null on 6/6. Two different sentinels for the same concept in one payload.

deals_snapshot_20260925.json.payload_not_byte_stable: A capture of the same URL on 2026-09-27 was also 54,901 bytes but sha256 a911cb3ab7d15e5e, with identical as_on_date, identical counters, identical array lengths, and all 6 rows retained by that session's trim present verbatim in this one. A row value was revised in place. Hence the 1-hour cache TTL and force_refresh.

pledge_yesbank_EMPTY.json.trim_rule: NO TRIM, and nothing to trim. This is a DELIBERATE NEGATIVE FIXTURE, not a failed capture: the route is live and answers 200 with a 28-byte empty envelope. Storing it is the point -- it is the evidence for 'reachable, empty, schema unverified' and the reason bfinance.ownership ships a probe instead of a pledge parser.

measured.window_asked_for: 2018-01-01 to 2026-09-2026, a symbol with a large pledged book
measured.VERDICT: route reachable, payload empty, ROW SCHEMA UNVERIFIED. Zero rows have ever been observed, so no pledge field name is verified and none is written anywhere in this package. Building a pledge parser against this fixture would produce a parser for a payload that has never existed.

fpi_foreign_ownership.why: A known blocked route, already recorded in src/bfinance/nse/marketlens.py. Not attempted, and no fixture stored: a 403 body is not a payload, and storing one would invite exactly the parser this module refuses to write.

blockdeal_sibling_route.why: Route gone. BLOCK_DEALS_DATA is in the largedeal payload above, so this request was never needed and was not spent.
